body.statement: For every \(0<\delta<\min\{c,C_0-c,\mu-1,B\}\), every sequence \(P_n\in\mathcal P_n\) satisfying \((c+\delta)n\le s_r(A)\le s_1(A)\le(C_0-\delta)n\), \(\max\{\|U\|_{2,\infty},\|V\|_{2,\infty}\}\le\sqrt{(\mu-\delta)r/n}\), and \(\max\{\|A\|_{\max},\|u\|_\infty,\|v\|_\infty\}\le B-\delta\), and every measurable interval sequence \(J_n\) satisfying \(\liminf_n\inf_{Q\in\mathcal P_n}Q\{\theta_n(Q)\in J_n\}\ge1-\alpha\), there exists \(k_\alpha>0\) such that \(\liminf_n\sup_{Q\in\mathcal N_n(P_n)}\mathbb E_Q[\operatorname{length}(J_n)]/w_n(P_n)\ge k_\alpha\).
body.justification: The converse certifies that the linear-plus-quadratic scale is intrinsic rather than an artifact of conservative inversion.
body.gap: Yan--Wainwright's genie-aided lower bound targets the regular first-order variance and does not establish transition-width necessity at joint loading degeneracy.
body.consumer: Methodologists comparing panel intervals receive an instance-local benchmark that projection or Bonferroni procedures can be measured against.
